title: People's Republic of Bulgaria
capsule: The People's Republic of Bulgaria was the communist state that governed Bulgaria from 1946/1948 to 1990 as a member of the Eastern Bloc and close Soviet ally. It was a one-party Marxist-Leninist state led by the Bulgarian Communist Party, with Todor Zhivkov as its long-serving leader for most of its existence. Its economy was centrally planned and collectivized.
